metadata.coverage_note: Rows below the threshold and unparsed reports are not drawn on this over-threshold map. Rows above the threshold without reviewed coordinates are counted as unmapped.
metadata.data_universe: Scraper-observed TPCHD Accela food-facility inspection records with parsed PDF reports; this public map layer includes only records over the red-point threshold.
metadata.freshness_note: Generated from the latest TPCHD scraper/publication run.
metadata.map_cannot_show: This map does not show neighborhood-level health risk, all inspections below the threshold, or rows without reviewed coordinates.
metadata.map_claim: Shows geocoded public restaurant inspection records with more than 35 red points.

privacy.review: Exact restaurant locations are public commercial facility addresses from public inspection records.

metadata.source_note: Tacoma-Pierce County Health Department Accela food-facility inspection pages and parsed inspection-report PDFs.

symbology.note: Over-threshold inspections are encoded with fixed red-point classes using darker red for higher totals, plus a diamond/exclamation symbol. Marker size does not encode red-point severity.

metadata.title: Tacoma-Pierce County restaurant inspections with more than 35 red points
